description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_URI responsible for validating CSS URIs in the context of the HTMLPurifier library. It extends functionality from a parent URI class to parse, sanitize, and ensure the correctness of URI strings embedded within CSS content.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_URI
classes.description: A class that validates CSS URIs, ensuring they conform to expected syntax and safety rules within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class instance, always setting the URI to be embedded.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given URI string by extracting it from CSS syntax, sanitizing, and ensuring it adheres to proper URI format and safety constraints, returning either a sanitized URL or false if invalid.
